question.problem:
What is the sum of the series $\,1-\frac{1}{9\cdot 2!}+\frac{1}{81\cdot 4!}-⋯+\frac{(-1)^{n}}{{3}^{2n}\cdot (2n)!}+⋯\,?$

The sum of the series is
{{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
We recognize that the series looks similar to the Maclaurin expansion for $f(x)=\operatorname{cos}⁡x:$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡x & =1-\frac{{x}^{2}}{2!}+\frac{{x}^{4}}{4!}-⋯+\frac{(-1)^{n}\,{x}^{2n}}{(2n)!}+⋯\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting $x=\frac{1}{3}$ into our Maclaurin expansion gives 

$$
\begin{aligned}cos\,(\frac{1}{3}) & =1-\frac{{(1/3)}^{2}}{2!}+\frac{{(1/3)}^{4}}{4!}-⋯+\frac{(-1)^{n}\,{(1/3)}^{2n}}{(2n)!}+⋯ \\ cos\,(\frac{1}{3}) & =1-\frac{1}{{3}^{2}\cdot 2!}+\frac{1}{{3}^{4}\cdot 4!}-⋯+\frac{(-1)^{n}}{{3}^{2n}\cdot (2n)!}+⋯ \\ cos\,(\frac{1}{3}) & =1-\frac{1}{9\cdot 2!}+\frac{1}{81\cdot 4!}-⋯+\frac{(-1)^{n}}{{3}^{2n}\cdot (2n)!}+⋯\,.\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, the sum of the series is $cos\,(\frac{1}{3}).$
